title: shifted-zeta-positivity: computer-assisted positivity for shifted zeta canonical systems (manuscripts, verification records, research log)
description:
Research program around Suzuki's shifted screw functions Ψω and the shifted scattering function Θω(z) = ξ(1/2 − ω − iz)/ξ(1/2 + ω − iz) for the Riemann zeta function: quantitative criteria for zero-free half-planes, the associated inverse-spectral (Krein string / canonical system) family, and computer-assisted positivity on the prime-free first slab.

This record archives the whole repository at a release tag. The six-paper Suzuki-based program lives under papers/shifted-zeta/; the separate Weil-positivity program has shared background under papers/susy-positivity/ and its current manuscript under papers/susy-positivity/attempts/positive-factorizations/, and the earlier detector work is under papers/misc/rh-detector/. Each manuscript folder has a STATUS or VERIFICATION_STATUS file; released paper sources also have citation metadata. The blueprint/ and statements/ directories give the statement inventory of the first-slab preprint with dependency graph, proof status, human-verification status and formalization feasibility; verification/ holds referee-round records, the verification checklist and numerical recomputation scripts (floating and high-precision diagnostics, not interval certificates). The primary first-slab Arb certificate code and its result tables are not in the public tree; their release gate is documented under code/. The notes/ directory holds the storage-depth lessons-learned note, the index and redaction checklist for the research log; the round reports themselves are migrated only after passing that checklist, and the index says which are present.

The preprint Archimedean first-slab positivity for shifted zeta canonical systems: an off-center Weil generator and a radial energy identity (folder papers/shifted-zeta/first-slab-positivity/, manuscript version 1.0) is the release-stage preprint intended for the planned first repository tag; no tag or DOI exists yet. The seven other manuscript folders (psi-omega-margin, omega-string, defect-depth, rh-detector, weil-depth, storage-depth, positive-factorizations) are present as clearly labelled working drafts with their reproduction code; archiving them does not endorse them as finished results, and each folder's STATUS.md records what has and has not been checked. Weil-depth and storage-depth carry code, small certificate records and archive guides; their large numerical data remain outside git in szp-archive. The rh-detector manuscript is a separate, earlier thread unrelated to the Suzuki program. Each released paper is also to be deposited as its own Zenodo record and linked to this one; such links are added to this metadata only once the records exist.

Disclosure: the work was produced with substantial language-model assistance and has not yet had line-by-line human verification of its central analytic steps; the per-statement status is recorded in the repository. Nothing here claims progress toward the Riemann hypothesis or a new zero-free region.
